mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_account_category ( code, name, budget_code, dr_cr_div, sort_order, is_use, description, print_name, reg_id, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{accCode}, #{accName}, #{budgetCode}, COALESCE(#{drCr}, 'DR'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 1), COALESCE(#{isUse}, 'Y'), #{remark}, #{printName}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, code as accCode, name as accName, budget_code AS budgetCode, dr_cr_div AS drCr, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_use AS isUse, description as remark, print_name AS printName, reg_id AS regId, reg_dt AS regDt, mod_id AS modId, mod_dt AS modDt FROM tb_account_category WHERE 1=1
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND budget_code = #{budget_code}
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, code ASC
